---
title: "Protein-detection model"
output: html_document
---

Cross-validated predictions from the source-specific elastic-net model are
provided for the 2,762 proteins used in model evaluation. The script recalculates
the correlation with observed detection, prediction error, and discrimination
of the Tier A+B core proteome. Source-head coefficients are included as a
separate input table.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "04_detection_model.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/04_detection_model/detection_model_performance.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

The assessment figure is written to
`analysis/04_detection_model/detection_model.pdf`.
